# CheckoutSkeleton, OrderSummarySkeleton

What the page shows while it loads. The shell appears at once; these grey shapes fade in 160ms later, so a fast load never flashes them, and pulse while they wait. `Checkout` shows them while its `loading` prop is true, then fades them out over 133ms as the real page fades in. Reload the full checkout to see the whole sequence.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/checkoutskeleton-ordersummaryskeleton)

## Usage

```tsx
// The whole page
<Checkout loading={!cart} items={cart?.lines ?? []} … />

// Or by hand, inside your own layout
<CheckoutLayout summary={ready ? <OrderSummary … /> : <OrderSummarySkeleton />}>
  {ready ? <form>…</form> : <CheckoutSkeleton />}
</CheckoutLayout>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `CheckoutSkeleton express` | `boolean` | Show the express row: a label and three button shapes. Default true. |
| `CheckoutSkeleton sections` | `number` | How many heading-and-two-lines sections. Default 2. |
| `OrderSummarySkeleton items` | `number` | How many product shapes. Default 1. |
| `Checkout loading` | `boolean` | Shows both skeletons in place of the form and the summary. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `CheckoutSkeleton.module.css`
- `CheckoutSkeleton.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/primitives/Skeleton`](../../primitives/Skeleton)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
